I think this needs to revisited to be sure that these are definitely duplicates. 

As @belalena points out in #1520, we also need to consider the levels. I personally do think that at this point we should consider 2.3.2 an L2 requirement to encourage the adoption of better authenticator mechanisms.

I think this needs to revisited to be sure that these are definitely duplicates. 

As @belalena points out in #1520, we also need to consider the levels.

Original requirements: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1013#issuecomment-850623232

2.2.7 seems like a principle rather than a requirement. For OTPs, how else are you going to authenticate without entering an OTP, for push notifications we should handle this point with #1415, for hardware, we should add this point to [2.2.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/1be23b974fabb7f80c536a55796ee63f2840b35a/5.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v22-general-authentication-security).

I also think that 2.3.2 duplicates 2.2.4. I would support merging it in but specify that L2 app should support these mechanisms and L3 apps should require them.

Proposal:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE | [NIST §](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **2.2.4** | [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.2.9, MERGED FROM 2.2.7, 2.3.2, L3 > L2] Verify that a hardware-based authentication mechanism is supported that provides verifier impersonation resistance against phishing attacks (such as WebAuthn) and verifies intent to authenticate by requiring a user-initiated action (such as a button press on a FIDO hardware key). For L3 apps, this should be required and not just supported. | | ✓ | ✓ | 308 | 4.3.1 |
| **2.2.7** | [DELETED, MERGED TO 2.2.4] | | | | | |
| **2.3.2** | [DELETED, MERGED TO 2.2.4] | | | | | |

<<DON'T RESPOND TO THIS YET>>
